description: A WINDOW with increment 0 arrives for a stream id that is retired (<= highest_opened, no live stream: opened, then RESET by the server). WIRE.md section 2.5 receive table, WINDOW row: the stale check comes first, so a WINDOW for a retired id is discarded and counted as stale whatever its increment, 0 included -- no RESET(PROTOCOL_ERROR), which applies only to increment 0 on a LIVE stream (frames/window_increment_zero.json), and no connection error. The stale counter itself is not observable to a wire-level harness; under --strict the error_code: null liveness probe fails on any RESET the client puts on the wire, so 'no RESET' is asserted. Companion of reset_on_closed_stream_toward_client.json and window_after_close.json.
